turns.text: Smart move. It's easy to get bogged down in the details, so pacing yourselves is a great strategy. Did you listen to anything interesting while you were putting that burrito bowl together earlier?

turns.text: I did! I put on a really funny comedy podcast while I was chopping up the ingredients. It had me laughing out loud in the kitchen, which was a nice change of pace.

turns.text: It's called 'SmartLess'. The hosts have such quick wit and their chemistry is just hilarious. It definitely brightened up my kitchen chores!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, I've heard great things about that one! They have fantastic guests. Sounds like a wonderful, relaxing day overall. Are you feeling rested and ready for your shifts at the outpatient clinic this week?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, definitely. Having a quiet Sunday like this really helps recharge my batteries before a busy week of nursing. Dash is currently asleep on my feet, so I think he agrees with the slow pace!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Aw, Dash knows exactly how to do Sundays right. Give him a gentle pat for me! I hope the rest of your evening is just as peaceful, Sofia.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I will! Thanks so much. Have a great night!
